# Contributing to This Project

We’re happy you’re here! Follow these steps to contribute.

## How to Report a Bug
- Use the "Bug Report" issue template.
- Provide clear steps to reproduce the issue.

## How to Suggest a Feature
- Use the "Feature Request" issue template.
- Explain why it’s useful and how it could work.

## Submitting a Pull Request
1. Fork the repo and create a branch (`git checkout -b feature-name`).
2. Make your changes and commit (`git commit -m "Add feature"`).
3. Push to your fork (`git push origin feature-name`).
4. Open a PR using the provided template.

## Code Style
- Follow [insert style guide, e.g., Airbnb JS Style Guide].
- Run tests before submitting.

## Questions?
Use the "Question" issue template or join our [Discord](https://discord.gg/example).

Thanks for contributing!
